derived_from: PDF text layer (pdftotext -layout and raw) + page images at 90 dpi (PDF pages 1, 3, 10). Table 1 (PDF page 10, printed page 8) transcribed from the page image and checked against the text layer. Header cells are stacked multi-line text in ONE header row, joined with single spaces (line-break hyphens that are real, e.g. 'House-passed', kept). Superscript footnote letters a-k are omitted from cells (e.g. 'Military Personneld' -> 'Military Personnel', '$10.0j' -> '$10.0', '$152.3k' -> '$152.3'); wrapped row labels joined with one space; '-' cells are printed dashes. Italic subset rows (TRICARE for Life, IC Mgmt. Account, (Mandatory) CIA Retirement Fund, Rescissions) are ordinary rows. Headings appear in the table of contents, so order uses passage openings instead.
